name: Burner
fix_description: In _convert, uses manipulable on-chain price/balance values. Fix: use TWAP oracle or add flash-loan protection.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is very short and essentially a simple two-step manipulation: buy PNT, call convertAndBurn with attacker-chosen token inputs, then sell back for profit. It involves minimal protocol complexity, no real flash-loan machinery in the test, and the vulnerable pattern appears straightforward once the burner logic is identified.
